retainedFailure.error: SQLite code 17: vtable constructor failed: messages_fts

cause: Concurrent processes could execute autocommit initialization and FTS rebuild phases against the same fresh profile.
fix: Hold a persistent canonical per-database OS advisory lock across writable open and migration, including FTS rebuild and VACUUM. Acquire an existing coordinator before read-only preflight and recheck the exact first-lookup race.
sensitivity: Removing the error-path coordinator recheck causes the deterministic preflight race regression to return an error while its pending assertion expects safe coordination.
limitations: Active symlink retarget by a profile-directory writer is outside this guarantee.
Published v0.4.4 does not honor this lock and must be closed before upgrading.
CLOEXEC is configured but a dedicated child-exec acceptance check is absent.
Source acceptance does not establish native startup-alert dismissal or packaged GUI behavior.
